title: TNoC
_note: The chipsalliance/sv-tests core (generators/tnoc), pinned at the commit sv-tests pins.  `rtl/bcm` is a SUBMODULE (taichi-ishitani/tbcm, the basic-component library every block builds on), so `submodules: true`; without it rtl/bcm/compile.f does not exist and the closure loses every tbcm_* dependency.  sv-tests drives the core through four compile.f lists (rtl/bcm, rtl/common, rtl/router, rtl/fabric); the roots below cover those plus rtl/axi_adapter.  No include directories: the tree uses packages, not `include.
